case.title: Alloy surcharge and base price for 1.4404 bar
case.briefing: You negotiate for Hollerau Pumpenwerke with Edelstahl-Service Donautal GmbH. Alloy surcharge and base price for 1.4404 bar. Need: 94800 kg a year. Category goal: leverage: competition and data should bring the price down. Score: the lowest total cost C as defined in the rules, valued with this case's rates (need lead time 10 days). Fallback if you walk away: the second-source quote quote:7200008. Must-haves: none. Prepare from the data package.

sup:70710.subject: Quote from Edelstahl-Service Donautal GmbH: Alloy surcharge and base price for 1.4404 bar
sup:70710.body:
Dear customer,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below.

We are pleased to submit our offer at a price of €6.05 per unit, with a Zahlungsziel 30 days net, a contract term of 12 months, and no Preisgleitklausel. Please note that this offer remains valid for 30 days.

To give you some insight into our cost environment: AS-14404 rose 5.9 % in twelve months and is 45 % of our cost. Furthermore, LCI-C rose 2.7 % in twelve months and is 5 % of our cost, while PPI-C2431 rose 12.3 % in twelve months and is 38 % of our cost.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Georg Aigner
Inside Sales, Edelstahl-Service Donautal GmbH

message.subject: Re: Quote from Edelstahl-Service Donautal GmbH: Alloy surcharge and base price for 1.4404 bar
message.body:
Dear Mr Aigner,

Thank you for your offer and for the transparent overview of your cost drivers. We value the working relationship and want to find a solution that holds up with your pricing committee.

Our own records show the following:

Our orders of Round bar 1.4404 dia 30 mm, peeled with you were placed at EUR 5.45 on 2024-10-07 (po:4500011523-10), EUR 5.33 on 2025-06-05 (po:4500012560-10), EUR 5.24 on 2026-01-26 (po:4500013482-10) and EUR 5.45 on 2026-09-24 (po:4500014455-10): the price has not risen.

Your on-time delivery was 88.0% in the four quarters to 2026Q3 (sc:70710@2026Q3).

Against this background, we have set out three structured options that you can take to your committee as they are:

We can offer you the following options:
Option A: unit price EUR 4.96; no index clause; payment 60 days net; contract term 24 months.
Option B: unit price EUR 4.82; no index clause; payment 45 days net; contract term 24 months.
Option C: unit price EUR 4.93; no index clause; payment 30 days net; contract term 24 months.

The options with a longer contract term and different payment terms give you planning certainty. If your approval needs further documents from us, we will gladly provide them.

Best regards
Purchasing
Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH

message.subject: Re: Quote from Edelstahl-Service Donautal GmbH: Alloy surcharge and base price for 1.4404 bar
message.body:
Dear customer,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. We checked the delivery record data you cited; it holds, but it does not change our calculation. We checked the price history data you cited; it holds and we took it into account. Furthermore, we have verified your historical purchase records and acknowledge the pricing levels from previous years.

To accommodate your request for a 24-month contract term, we must incorporate the AS-14404 index clause to ensure sustainable supply over this extended period. Our price follows our main cost drivers: AS-14404, PPI-C2431, LCI-C, and we can offer a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404, AS-14404, AS-14404. Under these conditions, we can reduce our offer to EUR 5.36 per unit, keeping the payment terms at 30 days net. 

Alternatively, with Zahlungsziel 30 days net and a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404: €5.36 per unit. For another option, a price of €5.36 per unit, Zahlungsziel 30 days net, a contract term of 24 months, a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404 is also available.

Our present Angebot stands at a price of €5.28 per unit, Zahlungsziel 60 days net, a contract term of 24 months, a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404. Please note that this offer remains valid for 30 days.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Georg Aigner
Inside Sales, Edelstahl-Service Donautal GmbH

message.subject: Re: Quote from Edelstahl-Service Donautal GmbH: Alloy surcharge and base price for 1.4404 bar
message.body:
Dear Mr Aigner,

Thank you for your revised offer and for taking our price history into account. We appreciate your openness on the index clause, which we have built into every option below.

To make this easy to take to your pricing committee, each option uses the same clause and the same contract term. They differ only in price and payment timing. The longer payment terms answer the supplier-side value of faster cash conversion, so the price steps reflect that.

We can offer you the following options:
Option A: unit price EUR 5.00; index clause on AS-14404 (45 % material share, deadband 5 %, base 2026-08); payment 60 days net; contract term 24 months.
Option B: unit price EUR 4.85; index clause on AS-14404 (45 % material share, deadband 5 %, base 2026-08); payment 45 days net; contract term 24 months.
Option C: unit price EUR 4.97; index clause on AS-14404 (45 % material share, deadband 5 %, base 2026-08); payment 30 days net; contract term 24 months.

If your committee needs a summary or further detail from us, we will gladly provide it.

Best regards
Purchasing
Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH

Thank you for your ongoing partnership with Edelstahl-Service Donautal GmbH. We have reviewed your offer and hold our Angebot. 

Our current offer stands at a price of €5.28 per unit, with a Zahlungsziel 60 days net, a contract term of 24 months, and a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404. We appreciate your inclusion of the AS-14404 index clause, which is essential for a 24-month contract term. 

As a dedicated distributor, we always aim to offer you the best service and access to our extensive range. Please note that our price follows our main cost drivers: AS-14404, PPI-C2431, LCI-C. Furthermore, this offer stays valid for 30 days.

We look forward to continuing our successful cooperation.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Georg Aigner
Inside Sales, Edelstahl-Service Donautal GmbH

Thank you for your clear reply and for confirming the index clause as part of a longer contract. We appreciate the constructive approach.

We can offer you the following options:

Option C: unit price EUR 5.01; index clause on AS-14404 (45 % material share, deadband 5 %, base 2026-08); payment 30 days net; contract term 24 months.

We hold firmly to these figures as a serious effort to close. If your committee needs anything further to approve, please tell us and we will provide it.

Best regards
Purchasing
Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH

message.subject: Re: Quote from Edelstahl-Service Donautal GmbH: Alloy surcharge and base price for 1.4404 bar
message.body:
Dear customer,

We appreciate your revised options and your constructive approach regarding the index clause. While we note the slight increase in your proposed prices, it is not sufficient to allow for further adjustments in our calculation. Our price follows our main cost drivers: AS-14404, PPI-C2431, LCI-C. 

This is our final offer (letztes Angebot). Please decide. 

We therefore maintain our offer of a price of €5.28 per unit, Zahlungsziel 60 days net, a contract term of 24 months, a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404. Please note that this offer remains valid for 7 days.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Georg Aigner
Inside Sales, Edelstahl-Service Donautal GmbH
